scope: Powerhouse One Loop / GitHub PR metadata / protected delivery
symptom: Required and BRAIN delivery evaluated stale or regressed PR delivery metadata, causing protected delivery to remain red even though the repository head itself remained on the canonical One Loop lineage.
root_causes: The first recovery merge changed the effective PR base from b573a31d0547979bf9c708e4f56da0fa27502688 to 5e9ae9f2633ffb1b0bdd07c2ba8b44b934d927b9 while older workflow events still carried a previous declared Base-SHA.
scripts/publish_approved_blog_v2.py was a legitimate changed path but was omitted from an earlier declared Change-Scope, producing SCOPE_CONTAMINATED during Required preflight.
Editing the PR body does not mutate an already-created pull_request event payload, and rerunning an existing workflow attempt can therefore reuse stale event metadata.

A concurrent metadata writer later regressed the live PR Base-SHA to cd2a1aa82662235744a93ea4981af954ec56b857, which BRAIN admission independently proved as DECLARED_BASE_SHA_MISMATCH against actual base 5e9ae9f2633ffb1b0bdd07c2ba8b44b934d927b9.
A synchronize event created before corrected PR metadata is persisted can still carry stale event payload even if live PR metadata is fixed seconds later.

Required run 35267316514 on head 139586eb18aa8fefa335276369a5c901c62d8b97 proved the event-snapshot boundary directly: live PR metadata already had Base-SHA 5e9ae9f2633ffb1b0bdd07c2ba8b44b934d927b9 and the complete Change-Scope, while preflight job 105357798137 still received the earlier PR_BODY snapshot with Base-SHA cd2a1aa82662235744a93ea4981af954ec56b857 and the old incomplete Change-Scope.

Required run 35267876652 on head f6ddee0826179740d01585224a0f6315b9afdc31 independently reproduced the same ordering boundary for a newly introduced path: its event PR_BODY omitted tools/delivery/delivery-metadata-authority.mjs while live PR readback already contained that path, so preflight job 105359554992 correctly failed SCOPE_CONTAMINATED on stale event metadata rather than on the live scope authority.
fix: Keep the existing canonical PR and branch. Persist the exact current Base-SHA and complete exact changed-path Change-Scope in the live PR first, verify that readback, then create this legitimate same-lineage learning writeback so GitHub emits a new synchronize event after metadata persistence. No parallel branch, PR, queue or product-lineage is created.
prevention: When protected CI consumes github.event.pull_request.body, treat the event payload as immutable per workflow run and never assume a later live PR edit changes an existing attempt.
When a gate fetches the PR live through the GitHub API, reconcile against the live body immediately before execution and fail closed on Base-SHA mismatch.
After an effective base change, update Base-SHA before requesting fresh protected checks.
Before expensive CI, compare changed paths with declared Change-Scope and report the first unexpected path exactly.
Persist PR metadata before creating the synchronize event that is intended to validate it.
Use a legitimate same-lineage writeback/synchronize event rather than close-reopen, force-push or parallel candidates when fresh PR event context is required.
If another writer moves the branch or rewrites PR metadata, re-read head/base/body and reconcile; never overwrite a moved head blindly.

A failed run whose embedded pull_request body differs from current raw PR readback is stale evidence: do not repair current code or metadata from that run; create or use the next legitimate synchronize event after correct metadata persistence.
terminal_acceptance: Remain RECOVERY_IN_PROGRESS until the new exact head has fresh Required and BRAIN delivery checks terminal green, is protected-merged with exact-head identity, and main/readback confirms the One Loop control-plane on protected main.
